requirementEvidence.title: Frozen research baseline
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Phase 1 uses one content-addressed research report as its frozen evidence baseline.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Verify and record the exact report SHA-256 before using it as Phase 1 research input.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not substitute a similarly named or later report without an approved evidence and change record.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Stable evidence metadata
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Fragile research citation tokens must be replaced by stable records containing source identity, date, location, access date, and claim mapping.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Maintain stable source records and leave unknown bibliographic fields null until verified.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not invent a title, publisher, date, URL, or citation mapping from token text or surrounding prose.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent
requirementEvidence.notes: The unresolved inventory contains 99 unique tokens and cannot yet satisfy this requirement for the underlying external claims.

requirementEvidence.title: Original expression and independent implementation
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: The simulator must be built from independently specified behavior using original code, expression, assets, formats, identities, and documentation.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Use simulator-owned requirements and original implementation for every product component.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: No copied or mechanically transformed vendor code, prose, layout, asset, schema, event code, or proprietary structure.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Default uncertain IP to Class 8
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: An unclassified or uncertain externally inspired item is high-risk until professional review resolves it.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Classify uncertain items as Class 8 and stop only the affected work.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not label an item probably permitted or downgrade its class to avoid review.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Classification before implementation
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Research-derived behavior cannot enter implementation before its evidence record has an IP classification and disposition.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Make evidence and IP disposition a merge-blocking implementation prerequisite.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not implement first and classify later.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Permitted research sources
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Only public vendor documentation, lawfully licensed standards, public law, independent corroboration, and counsel-protocol observations are eligible evidence categories.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Register and review every relied-upon source before use.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not treat public availability as permission to redistribute or use source expression as a production asset.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Forbidden research material
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Confidential, leaked, reverse-engineered, extracted, circumvention-derived, pirated, or copied vendor expression is inadmissible.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Reject forbidden material and quarantine suspected derivative work.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: No decompilation, disassembly, memory scraping, resource extraction, protocol reproduction capture, format cracking, piracy, bypass, or copied screenshot/manual asset.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Installed-product observation gate
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Installed TIA Portal observation for implementation verification requires prior license review and a written counsel-approved protocol.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Prohibit installed-product observation unless the exact approved protocol is linked.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not perform informal visual verification, capture screens, or rely on unreviewed EULA assumptions.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Vendor evidence quarantine
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Vendor screenshots and assets must stay out of production source, designs, tickets, prompts, corpora, mockups, and asset pipelines unless counsel approves quarantined evidence handling.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Keep research evidence isolated and use original expression.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not use vendor imagery or prose as a design or generator reference.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Public comparative statement gate
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Public comparative wording mentioning Siemens or TIA Portal requires exact trademark-counsel approval.
requirementEvidence.sourcePointer: Section 6.4, Trademark, trade dress, and public language
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Hold public comparative text and notices outside release until approved verbatim.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not infer approval from factual accuracy, nominative use, educational purpose, or a disclaimer.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Repository clean-room policy
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: A controlling clean-room policy must exist before feature implementation.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Maintain CLEAN_ROOM_POLICY.md as a merge and release control.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not treat a policy filename or unsigned template as proof that contributions complied.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Requirement evidence register
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Every research-derived requirement needs traceable source, classification, disposition, ownership, review, implementation, and verification metadata.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Maintain a valid machine-readable evidence register and fail closed on incomplete implementation records.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not use prose-only citations, orphan source tokens, or absent reviewer fields as verified evidence.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Suspected contamination quarantine
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Suspected contamination must be isolated from builds, prompts, generated assets, and derivative work until reviewed.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Stop the affected work, record minimum incident metadata, and quarantine all possible derivatives.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not continue using a suspected source while waiting for review or sanitize it through an automated tool.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Confirmed contamination clean rewrite
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Confirmed contamination requires a clean rewrite without reuse of tainted code, prose, assets, naming, layouts, or extracted structure.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Document affected scope, purge evidence, clean-room personnel, rewrite basis, and verification.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not rename, reformat, translate, or lightly rewrite tainted material.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Contributor clean-room attestation
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Contributors must attest that forbidden sources, reverse-engineering output, protocol captures, confidential material, and unregistered assets were not used.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Require a contribution-specific signed and reviewed attestation before acceptance.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not treat the blank form, a repository-wide assumption, or contributor silence as an attestation.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Asset provenance register
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Every shipped non-code asset needs identity, source, license evidence, date, hash, derivative chain, generation disclosure, and review approval.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Register and approve each exact asset hash before it can ship.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not approve an asset by folder, filename, generator name, or package license alone.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Reject unapproved assets
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: CI must reject shipped assets that are absent from the provenance register or lack approval.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Compare packaged asset hashes against approved provenance records and fail closed.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not rely on manual spot checks or allow unknown files because they appear harmless.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Release SBOM and license review
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Release artifacts require an SBOM and review of direct, transitive, optional, native, font, and asset licenses.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Generate a complete SBOM and notice set from the exact release resolution and packaged output.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not report only direct package manifests or omit optional, native, WebAssembly, font, and asset components.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Block incompatible dependency licenses
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: A dependency is rejected when its obligations conflict with intended distribution or cannot be satisfied and documented.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Review every resolved dependency version, features, artifacts, license obligations, and intended distribution before approval.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not approve a dependency from its SPDX label, popularity, transitive status, or presence in a lockfile alone.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

requirementEvidence.title: Evidence and production asset separation
requirementEvidence.paraphrasedObservedBehavior: Research notes and evidence records must remain separate from production assets and shipped bundles.
requirementEvidence.simulatorOwnedImplementationRequirement: Store evidence in governed research records and exclude it from production asset roots and packaging.
requirementEvidence.forbiddenImplementationShortcut: Do not package manuals, screenshots, research archives, or citation caches with the application.
requirementEvidence.author: Codex Phase 1 implementation agent

riskClosureEvidenceSchema.purpose: A CLOSED or ACCEPTED risk requires one independently reviewable evidence record; changing RISK_REGISTER.md text alone is never closure.
rules: disposition must exactly match the CLOSED or ACCEPTED status in RISK_REGISTER.md
every evidenceRecordId must resolve to an APPROVED and VERIFIED requirementEvidence record with reviewer and reviewDate
every verificationId must identify a passing check in the same closure run
an OPEN risk must not have an active riskClosureEvidence record
